baseline.evidencePolicy: Source hashes must match this snapshot before reusing gate results. The historical audit report remains unchanged.

changes.detail: After isAvailable returns, recheck the operation's terminal state before reserving an attempt, scheduling its timer or invoking transport. Synchronous cancellation therefore cannot create new work after finish().
After aborting a failed attempt, recheck terminal state before calling onFailure. An abort subscriber that cancels the parent cannot trigger failure-classifier side effects after cancellation.
Four permanent cases cover both defects in serial and parallel modes, including timer cleanup, cancellation of parallel peers, suppression of queued work and late completion.

Two consumer regression cases cover nested serial/parallel account executors. Reentrant parent cancellation preserves ready account state, releases timers, skips runtime classification and starts no queued accounts; assertions respect the random selection policy.

checks.detail: Terminal cancellation now prevents new attempts and post-cancellation failure callbacks. Routing and direct account consumer tests pass with all timers released. Existing request order, concurrency, replay-safety, proxy-health and stale-result tests remain passing.

The four new routing cases were first run against the original implementation: 24 existing cases passed and all four new cases failed. After the fix, 28 routing and 22 account-pool cases pass, including six new retained regression cases.

verification.phase: before product fix, after retaining regression tests
verification.summary: 4 new regression cases failed; 24 existing tests passed.

Root scripts and workspace tests passed, including Userscript/Tauri tests, Rust workspace tests and the 183-case TS/Rust protocol differential. The Rust subprocess fixture retains its existing ignored annotation; no live product acceptance is claimed.
Workspace TypeScript/Vue checks and Tauri's Rust boundary/fmt/clippy checks passed.
Package boundaries, plugin isolation/VM, mobile ACL boundaries and oxlint passed.

Twelve pre-existing maintained documentation files fail formatting. All twelve files are byte-identical to HEAD as verified by Git blob hashes. None of the three source/test changes was reported by this full check.
Root production build passed for Userscript and Tauri desktop; the optimized desktop executable was produced. Compilation/bundling is artifact evidence only, not live transport acceptance.
